title: Multiple Giant Succular and Fusiform Right and Left Coronary Artery Aneurysms after Early and Adequate Treatment of Atypical Kawasaki Disease with Unusual Presentation

sections.abstract: The major complication of Kawasaki disease is coronary artery dilatation and aneurysm. It occurs in approximately 15-25% of untreated children with Kawasaki Disease. Early diagnosis and treatment with Intravenous immune globulin (IVIG) and aspirin (ASA) can reduce the incidence of coronary artery abnormality to 2%-5%. We report one case of Atypical Kawasaki Disease with Multiple giant coronary artery aneurysms despite early adequate treatment with IVIG and ASA.
